item.title: Ringgit opens near seven-year high, boosted by OPR hold
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The ringgit opened stronger against the US dollar on Monday, nearing its highest level in more than seven years due to increased risk appetite following Bank Negara Malaysia’s (BNM) decision to maintain the Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) and the low US dollar index. At 8am, the ringgit strengthened to 3.9850/9950 against the US dollar from 4.0045/0080 recorded last Friday. item.title: US$1 exchange rate now below RM4 for the first time since July 2015
item.description: THE exchange rate from the United States (US) dollar to the Malaysian Ringgit this morning was below RM4 for the first time since July 2015.
